svg.text: Fixed N2-blanketed catch under each Enigma brew-module outlet head → 3-way diverter (BATCH / WASTE) → 3/16 in silicone drop line to the chilling coil · package §8 / §2.6 · gas per DWG D4 leg A
SECTION B-B — THROUGH SPOUT ℄ (front at left)
spout tip (1 of 2) — head on manual slide,
neck: bore Ø8 → Ø4.76 (3/16 in) taper,
tray rear lip — height unpublished: MEASURE
(VERIFY #9); keep ≥ 15° neck fall over the lip
Enigma drip tray — funnel base sits on tray / grid
2 × Ø4 locating pins (shown rotated in): positions
DETAIL C — N2 GALLERY AT RIM (enlarged)
1. Machined 316 bowl (from solid), wall 1.5; lid 316 or
PTFE disc 3 thk, drop-in, 2 lip. Food-contact build;
passivate ASTM A967; interior polished Ra ≤ 0.8 µm.
2. Funnel = the system surge buffer: ≈ 30 mL to the
overflow relief, which faces the DRIP TRAY — a
blocked coil overflows benignly to the tray (§11).
3. No pockets: floor falls ≥ 10° to the rear neck; neck
falls ≥ 15° continuously through the 1/4 NPT boss.
4. Spout head slides manually (≤ 200 mm cup clearance);
set 20–40 mm above lid at commissioning (VERIFY #2).
Fixed catch — nothing swings through the openings.
5. N2 ≈ 0.5 L/min per funnel (DWG D4 leg A); 0.5 mm jets
balance the two funnels; excess gas exits UP through
the spout openings — room air never enters.
food-safe PTFE tape on threads. Detented; WASTE =
resting state; BATCH once per session (§2.6). Valve
passage is in the CIP path — flick both ways in rinse.
7. Purge: lid lifts off; tapered purge stopper (D4 leg C)
8. QTY 2 — one per brew module; parts identical.
P — spout-to-spout pitch within a head; unpublished —
MEASURE at the Eversys demo (VERIFY #1). Placeholder 40.
ØS — spout openings = measured spout-tip Ø + 3 clearance;
PINS — Ø4 locating-pin positions site-fit to the Enigma
Working height 20–40 above lid — set at slide (VERIFY #2).
